transcription.iv15: Vel Recipe castorei, piperis albi, costi, menthæ, apii, ana drac. i. terantur, & distemperentur cum vino albo vel dulci, & da sero drach. ij.
transcription.v19: Experimentum probatissimum ad Matricem egressam. Recipe pulveris de corde cervi, foliorum lauri, ana drach. i, myrrhæ, scrup. i. distemperentur trita cum vino, & dentur potanda; & sic Matrix revertetur in suum locum.
transcription.surface_policy: Line-break hyphens are expanded; abbreviations and punctuation retained. The printed i/j numeral forms are represented as i and ij. No botanical or medical modernization.
uncertainties: apii final i/j letterform is normalized in the transcription.
ana scope in V19 covers the heart-powder and laurel-leaf pair; myrrh has separate scruple amount, but exact punctuation scope is an editorial reading.
trita scope and grammatical attachment remain uncertain.
distemperentur means a broad temper/mix instruction, not a forced modern chemical process.
IV15 wine quantity and whether two drachms refers to dry or finished preparation are unstated.
V19 wine type, wine quantity, dose and administration time are unstated.
probatissimum is retained as source rhetoric, not verified efficacy.

iv15.antecedent_scope: prior evening prescription, exact discourse boundary retained as source context

scope_correction.reason: wine amount and dose referent are unstated

target_policy: No target selection or access. Exploratory joint hypotheses may use the packet without prior independent target translation, but any fixed writer must preserve the complete typed AST and expose all unknown scopes.
medical_status: Historical source report only; no medical recommendation or factual efficacy claim.
